top_signals.title: Shaker: Demand in Mecca Driven by Faith not Cycles
top_signals.summary: Indonesia's sovereign investment body Danantara has completed a $533 million property acquisition in Mecca. Thakher Development announced the handing over of the title, marking the first time land at Thakher Makkah has been made available to investors from outside Saudi Arabia. Faisal Shaker, CEO of Thakher Development spoke to Bloomberg’s Abeer Abu Omar on Horizons Middle East & Africa on property ownership in one of the Holy Cities in Saudi Arabia. (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: US Army showing interest in G/ATOR missile-killing radar, Northrop says
top_signals.summary: Northrop Grumman’s new multi-mission radar system has earned high marks from Marine Corps leadership. The U.S. Army has taken notice.

top_signals.title: Turkey Removes Market Regulator Chief During Fund Crisis
top_signals.summary: Turkish President Recep Tayyip Erdogan removed the country’s market regulator chief Mahmut Sutcu following his resignation bid amid a fallout of a fund crisis that’s upended the country’s markets.

top_signals.title: Andorra and San Marino sign Association Agreement to move closer to the EU
top_signals.summary: European Commission Press release Brussels, 19 Oct 2026 Today, the Commission signed an Association Agreement with Andorra and San Marino, bringing both countries closer to the EU and establishing a clear and comprehensive framework for deeper economic and institutional integration.
